item.title: How Charter and Comcast are building their way out of Verizon dependency
item.description: By selective buildouts using small cells and CBRS, cable operators are moving quickly to transform the wireless industry.

item.title: Plume acquires Sweepr
item.description: Wi-Fi tech and management specialist has acquired Sweepr, an AI-focused provider of customer care technologies and services. #pressrelease

item.title: FCC details plan to supercharge Wi-Fi
item.description: The FCC has shed more light on a proposal to boost Wi-Fi performance in the 6GHz band using a new class of higher-powered 'GVP' devices that will be governed by 'exclusion zones' to mitigate interference with others in the band.

item.title: Global PC shipments grew 9% in 2025, but memory and storage supply issues threaten 2026 outlook – Omdia
item.description: Global PC shipments grew 9% in 2025, but memory and storage supply issues threaten 2026 outlook – Omdia

item.title: Ukrainian 5G pilot launches in Lviv
item.description: A pilot of 5G technology has started in Ukraine, in the city of Lviv, but a full rollout of the technology will have to wait.

item.title: CommScope completes Amphenol deal, becomes Vistance Networks
item.description: CommScope has closed the sale of its Connectivity and Cable Solutions (CCS) unit to Amphenol. Amphenol is also getting the CommScope brand and CommScope is rebranding as Vistance Networks. #pressrelease

item.title: Plume scoops up Sweepr
item.description: Plume is expanding into AI-based customer care via the acquisition of Sweepr, an Ireland-based startup that counts Telus and Eir among its marquee customers.

item.title: New York opens applications for municipal broadband grants
item.description: New York has re-opened applications for the state's Municipal Infrastructure Program (MIP), making up to $36 million available to support broadband projects. #pressrelease

item.title: CommScope goes back to the future with Aurora Networks rebrand
item.description: Amphenol is getting the CommScope brand after closing its deal to purchase CommScope's Connectivity & Cable Solutions unit. What's left of CommScope is becoming Vistance Networks, with its access unit rebranding as Aurora Networks.

item.title: Acer sues AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile over patents
item.description: Acer has filed lawsuits against AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile in the US District Court for the Eastern District of Texas seeking compensation for the companies' use of Acer's patent-protected technology. #pressrelease
